verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.26
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.26

verses.pali: 3. Puggalavagga
verses.english: 3. Individuals

verses.pali: Sevitabbasutta
verses.english: Associates

verses.pali: “Tayome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “These three individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame tayo?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: There is an individual you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend.

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: There is an individual you should associate with, accompany, and attend.

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo sakkatvā garuṁ katvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: There is an individual you should associate with, accompany, and attend with honor and respect.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo?
verses.english: Who is the individual you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo hīno hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is inferior in terms of ethics, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo aññatra anuddayā aññatra anukampā.
verses.english: You shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend such an individual, except out of kindness and sympathy.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo?
verses.english: Who is the individual you should associate with, accompany, and attend?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sadiso hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is similar in terms of ethics, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: You should associate with, accompany, and attend such an individual.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Sīlasāmaññagatānaṁ sataṁ sīlakathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati.
verses.english: Thinking, ‘Since our ethical conduct is similar, we can discuss ethics, the conversation will flow, and we’ll both be at ease.

verses.pali: Samādhisāmaññagatānaṁ sataṁ samādhikathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati.
verses.english: Since our immersion is similar, we can discuss immersion, the conversation will flow, and we’ll both be at ease.

verses.pali: Paññāsāmaññagatānaṁ sataṁ paññākathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissatīti.
verses.english: Since our wisdom is similar, we can discuss wisdom, the conversation will flow, and we’ll both be at ease.’

verses.pali: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: That’s why you should associate with, accompany, and attend such an individual.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo sakkatvā garuṁ katvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo?
verses.english: Who is the individual you should associate with, accompany, and attend with honor and respect?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo adhiko hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is superior in terms of ethics, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo sakkatvā garuṁ katvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: You should associate with, accompany, and attend such an individual with honor and respect.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Iti aparipūraṁ vā sīlakkhandhaṁ paripūressāmi, paripūraṁ vā sīlakkhandhaṁ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmi;
verses.english: Thinking, ‘I’ll fulfill the entire spectrum of ethical conduct I haven’t yet fulfilled, or support with wisdom in every situation the ethical conduct I’ve already fulfilled.

verses.pali: aparipūraṁ vā samādhikkhandhaṁ paripūressāmi, paripūraṁ vā samādhikkhandhaṁ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmi;
verses.english: I’ll fulfill the entire spectrum of immersion I haven’t yet fulfilled, or support with wisdom in every situation the immersion I’ve already fulfilled.

verses.pali: aparipūraṁ vā paññākkhandhaṁ paripūressāmi, paripūraṁ vā paññākkhandhaṁ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmīti.
verses.english: I’ll fulfill the entire spectrum of wisdom I haven’t yet fulfilled, or support with wisdom in every situation the wisdom I’ve already fulfilled.’

verses.pali: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo sakkatvā garuṁ katvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: That’s why you should associate with, accompany, and attend this individual with honor and respect.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasminti.
verses.english: These are the three individuals found in the world.

verses.pali: Nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī,
verses.english: A man who associates with an inferior goes downhill,

verses.pali: Na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī;
verses.english: but associating with an equal, you’ll never decline;

verses.pali: Seṭṭhamupanamaṁ udeti khippaṁ,
verses.english: following the best, you’ll quickly rise up,

verses.pali: Tasmā attano uttariṁ bhajethā”ti.
verses.english: so you should keep company <j>with people better than you.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
